item.title: CVE-2026-88771 Citrix netscaler application delivery controller: Improper input validation vulnerability in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway.
item.description:
Improper input validation vulnerability in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway.
This issue affects ADC: before 14.1-73.37, before 13.1-64.23, before 14.1-73.37 FIPS, and before 13.1.37.279 FIPS and NDcPP; Gateway: before 14.1-73.37 and before 13.1-64.23 leading to an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands. | CVSS 9.8 | Known exploited (CISA KEV, added 2026-09-27) | EPSS 1.1%
